title: FlightPath Prompt Schema
description: Schema for FlightPath prompts. Prompts should be in final-form format with all context variables (e.g., @workspace, #file:path, #selection) and slash commands (e.g., /fix, /explain) included directly in the prompt text.

finalPrompt.description: A prompt that always runs after all queued prompts complete. If allowDynamicExtension is true and finalPrompt appends prompts, those prompts run before finalPrompt executes again.

originalFile.description: Path to original prompt file (working files only)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when workflow started (working files only)

executionProperties.description: Shared execution configuration properties used across workflow-level defaults, prompt-level overrides, and runtime metadata

harness.description: Agent Harness/framework to use for this prompt. Determines which CLI or chat integration to use. Optional - defaults to flightpath.harness setting.

model.description: AI model to use for this prompt. Available models are queried dynamically from your Copilot subscription. Use IntelliSense (Ctrl+Space) to see available models. CLI mode supports limited models (claude-sonnet-4.5, claude-sonnet-4, claude-haiku-4.5, gpt-5) - others will fallback to default with warning. Optional - defaults to flightpath.copilotCliModel setting.

agent.description: Custom agent to use for this prompt. Specify ONLY the agent name without file extensions (e.g., 'flightpath-orchestrator' for file 'flightpath-orchestrator.agent.md'). The agent's instructions will be prepended to your prompt using <agentInstructions> tags. Agents are discovered from .github/agents/, .claude/agents/, or user prompts directory. Works with all providers (Copilot CLI, Claude CLI, Codex CLI, Copilot Chat).

resumeSession.description: Whether to resume the existing chat session for this prompt. When omitted, defaults to the flightpath.resumeExistingSession setting (default: false). Set to true to continue in the existing session for context continuity. Retries continue in the same session by default; set endCondition.resumeSessionOnRetry=false to start a fresh session for each retry.

allowDynamicExtension.description: Enable dynamic queue extension for this prompt. When true: CLI modes (copilot-cli, claude-cli, codex-cli) pass MCP server configuration to enable flightpath_append_queue and flightpath_queue_status tools. Chat mode injects instructions to use these tools via Language Model Tools API. When false, no MCP config or instructions are provided. When omitted, defaults to true for last prompt only (when no other prompts have explicit flags).

sessionId.description: Session ID for resuming CLI conversations. Can be: a string (exact CLI session ID to resume), a number (prompt reference: 1 = use session from first prompt), or the special value "finalPrompt" (resume the session established by the previous finalPrompt loop iteration — on the first iteration a new session starts). When omitted and resumeSession=true, automatically resumes previous prompt's session. Working file runtime metadata stores the actual session ID used during execution.

skills.description: List of skill names to attach to this prompt. Only the skill frontmatter is attached (progressive disclosure) — the harness reads the full SKILL.md when using the skill. Skills are discovered from .claude/skills/ directories (workspace and user home). Prompt-level skills replace workflow-level skills (no merging).

priorContext.description: Controls injection of prior prompt outputs into this prompt's text before sending to the AI. 'all' injects all prior outputs; 'previous' injects the immediately preceding output; 'none' disables injection; an array of integers ([1, 3]) injects specific prompts by 1-based index. When omitted, no context is injected. Note: combining with resumeSession:true may duplicate context (accepted limitation).

oneOf.description: Keyword shorthand: 'all' = all prior queue prompt outputs, 'previous' = immediately preceding queue prompt output, 'none' = no injection, 'finalPromptAll' = all previous finalPrompt loop outputs, 'finalPromptPrevious' = immediately preceding finalPrompt loop output
Specific prior prompt numbers to include (1-based, e.g. [1, 3] includes prompts 1 and 3)

additionalArgs.description: Additional CLI flags appended to FlightPath's standard argument set. FlightPath continues to manage model, permissions, workspace dirs, and session flags normally. Tokens are injected before the tool permission args. Applies only to CLI harnesses (copilot-cli, claude-cli, codex-cli, opencode-cli). Ignored for copilot-chat. Example: "--effort high --max-turns 10"

name.description: Optional human-readable display label shown in the FlightPath dashboard. If omitted, the dashboard shows a truncated preview of the prompt text.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to GitHub Copilot. Can be either: (1) Final-form prompt text with context variables (@workspace, #file:path:line-line, etc.) and slash commands (/fix, /explain, etc.) directly in the text, OR (2) A file path to a .prompt.md, .md, or .txt file containing the prompt. File paths are resolved relative to the prompt file's directory, then workspace root, then .flightpath directory. Absolute paths are also supported.

_runtime.description: Per-prompt runtime execution metadata (optional, added automatically during execution)

script.description: Path to script file to execute, or direct shell command (e.g., 'npm test', 'python script.py'). File paths are resolved relative to workspace root or .flightpath directory.

returns.description: Expected output from script (stdout). Matching rules: (1) Exact match (case-insensitive), (2) Boolean: 'true' matches true/1/yes/pass/passed, 'false' matches false/0/no/fail/failed, (3) Numeric: compared as >= (e.g., '90' matches if script outputs 90 or higher), (4) Substring: matches if output contains this string

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when validation fails. Use -1 for unlimited retries (use with caution), 0 for no retries (default), or 1-100 for a specific limit.

retryPrompt.description: Template for retry prompt with placeholders: {scriptOutput}, {errorOutput}, {expectedValue}, {actualValue}, {retryCount}, {maxRetries}

resumeSessionOnRetry.description: Whether retries continue in the same session. Default: true (retries resume the existing session for context continuity). Set to false to start a fresh session for each retry.

promptRuntimeMetadata.description: Per-prompt runtime execution metadata (optional, added automatically during execution)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when this prompt started execution

completedAt.description: Timestamp when this prompt completed execution

retryCount.description: Number of retry attempts for this prompt

responseText.description: Plain-text AI response from this prompt's execution. Written automatically during workflow execution. Used by the priorContext feature to inject prior prompt outputs.

runtimeMetadata.description: Workflow-level runtime execution state for working files (optional, added automatically by FlightPath during execution)

finalPrompt.description: Runtime metadata for finalPrompt execution state (optional, added automatically during execution)

responseTexts.description: Response texts from each finalPrompt loop execution, indexed by loop number (0-based). Written automatically during workflow execution. Used by the priorContext 'finalPromptAll' and 'finalPromptPrevious' keywords.
